Clinical case 1 : (Questions from 5 to 8)
A 55-year-old woman, newly menopaused, diabetic she is on insulin therapy since childhood.
goes for medical consultation. She reports general fatigue, insomnia which is becoming more
frequent with a feeling of tachycardia and fingers tremor which have deeply worried her
because they have increased over the past 4 months.
Clinical examination found exaggerated tendon reflexes with slight proptosis.
The results of the biological assessment being requested are as follows:
Free T4: 66 pg/ml (6.5 - 20 pg/ml) and TSH: 0.03 mU/l (0.4-4 mIU/l)

Clinical case 2 : (Questions from 11 to 12)
A mother takes her 16-year-old daughter for consultation for primary amenorrhea.
The questioning revealed android hairiness in the girl (identical to the distribution of hair in
the male sex) and a history of two mother’s male infants death caused by an infectious
process.
The abdomino-pelvic ultrasound of the young girl reveals a tumoral process in the
retroperitoneum.
